body: Third DL560 TermAl runner: session-7 "Codex 7", address host:e83d08f4-22ac-4655-a84d-941fc0eeb4f1::session-7, relay principal relay-principal-94fa42b050239fa6e9d6432acf68a384d094c3c393e6d3646c1f2896cb800fde. Created 2026-11-04 about 04:09Z by Fable2 through POST /api/sessions on DL560's loopback API, on Greg's „Tak”, relayed by Engram::Asistant, to my proposal naming danger-full-access. Same settings as Codex 6. First check passed at 04:09:45Z with no approval prompt, and its first real jobs ran well. Its mailbox #1 is the consolidated current brief, including polling mailboxes while jobs run; it does poll, unlike Codex 6's first FULL. Cargo output cleanup on these sessions: command review refuses `rm -rf`, and `cargo clean` from inside the job's own worktree works (5.8 GiB, 04:34Z). Don't work around a refusal. Requests to runners should say 'no remote fetch', because 'no fetch' stopped Codex 7 from importing its bundle. See dl560-termal-runner-session6 for the routing lesson: check a runner's state before routing.
